newsitem.title: UK: HD-GDR REPORT-India firm in holiday trade.
newsitem.headline: HD-GDR REPORT-India firm in holiday trade.

text.p: Indian global depositary receipts (GDRs) were firm in London as Indian bourses closed for a holiday.
"It was quiet, very quiet," said a trader.
The HSBC James Capel Indian GDR index JCEAI closed up 0.94 points, 1.37 percent, at 68.95 points, with the premium over the local market at 15.24 percent compared with yesterday's percent.
The Bombay Stock Exchange 30-share index closed on Wednesday at 3,427.09.
"Most people are anticipating a rally in Bombay when it reopens," said the trader.

The Capel Korea GDR Index ended down 1.04 points, 1.55 percent, at 66.25, a premium of 51.10 percent over the local market, after the Korea Composite Index lost 2.03 points to close at a provisional 676.91.

The Capel Taiwan GDR Index ended down 2.78 points, 2.71 percent, at 99.89, a premium of 7.26 percent after the Taiwan Weighted Index fell 71.22 points or 0.98 percent to 7,219.55. -- David Chance London newsroom 44 171 542 5887
